DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 49 s. 2022 June 6, 2022 DIR. JOSEPHINE CABRIDO-LEYSA DILG Regional Office XII Prime Regional Government Center Carpenter Hill, Koronadal City 9506 Dear Dir. Cabrido-Leysa. This pertains to your letter dated 04 April 2022 concerning the request for advice from Ms. Josephine M. Abellana, CAO/PAATSDD Head, LGU-Cotabato, on whether the following activities are allowed during the election ban: I. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. Actual distribution of cash incentives amounting to P 1,000 per annum; Actual distribution of meals, snacks to BPAT members; Gathering of Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team (BPAT) beneficiaries with prepared programs; Giving of speeches from incumbent officials during the program; Giving of speeches from political allies of the incumbent during the program, and Installation of tarpaulin with pictures of incumbent officials and slogan "Masaganang Cotabato, Dumaki". The concerned DILG Regional office presented a position that "the activities contemplated by the Public Affairs Assistance, Tourism and Spotts Development Division (PAA TSDD) of the Provincial Government, taken as a whole, is covered by the prohibition under Section 261 (o) of Batas Pambansa No. 881 or the Omnibus Election Code. " We concur to that position. The use of government funds in election campaigns and rallies or even on disguised local government activities but tend to support an electoral candidate is an election offense proscribed under Section 261 (o), Title XXII, of the Omnibus Election Code, viz: "Section 261 Prohibited Acts: xxx o. Use of public funds, money deposited in trust, equipment, facilities owned or controlled by the government for an election campaign. - Any person who uses under any guise whatsoever, directly or indirectly, (I) public funds or money deposited with, or held in trust by, public financing institutions or by government offices, banks, "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

audio-visual equipment operated by the Govemment or by its divisions, sub-divisions, agencies or instrumentalities, including govemment-owned or controlled corporations, or by the Armed Forces of the Philippines; or (3) any equipment, vehicle, facility, apparatus, or paraphernalia owned by the govemment or by its political subdivisions, agencies including government-owned or controlled corporations, or by the Armed Forces of the Philippines for any election campaign or for any partisan political activity. " The Department, pursuant to Section 52 (b) of R.A. No. 6975, otherwise known as the "Department of the Interior and Local Government Act of 1990", is duty bound to enforce compliance to the non-partisan policy among LGUs to ensure that no government funds and properties are wasted for non-governmental matters to the detriment and prejudice of the general public. Election campaigns and rallies, as well as political support by incumbent officials to candidates, are not imbued with governmental functions, they are private matters. Thus, they are to be considered separate from public officials and employees' governmental positions and functions. We must emphasize that there should not be any form of election-related agenda in all programs undertaken by Local Governments, more so when expenditure of government funds is involved. In addition, may we also direct attention to COMELEC Resolution No. 10747, RULES AND REGULATIONS ON PROHIBITION AGAINST RELEASE, DISBURSEMENT OF PUBLIC FUNDS AND CONSTRUCTION OF PUBLIC WORKS, AND ISSUANCE OF TREASURY WARRANTS AND SIMILAR DEVICES (SECTION 261 (V), (W) OF THE OMNIBUS ELECTION CODE) IN CONNECTION WITH MAY 9, 2022 SYNCHRONIZED NATIONAL AND LOCAL ELECTIONS. Considering, however, of the passing of the 2022 Presidential and Local Elections and the termination of the period of prohibition provided by Section 2 of COMELEC Resolution No. 10747, the foregoing discussion is respectfully forwarded for academic discussion and for further guidance it may serve. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, INGAN r ry for Local Government Under OUSLG/ML1/LLLS-LRALLD/kbm Page 2 of 2
